description.zh: 座席工号；取值3-10位正整数，参数cno,uniqueId和requestUniqueId三选一
description.en: The agent ID. The ID must be a 3- to 10-digit positive integer. Specify only one of the following parameters: Cno, UniqueId, or RequestUniqueId.

description.zh: 请求唯一标识；参数cno,uniqueId和requestUniqueId三选一。注意：requestUniqueId挂机功能只在呼叫类型为webcall时生效，且需提前在管理后台将功能开启
description.en: The unique request ID. Specify only one of the following parameters: Cno, UniqueId, or RequestUniqueId. Note: This parameter applies only to calls of the webcall type. You must first enable this feature in the management console.

description.zh: 是否座席侧挂机；取值范围：1,2（数字含义，座席侧，非座席侧)，默认座席侧
description.en: The party to disconnect from the call. Valid values: 1 (agent) and 2 (non-agent). Default: 1.

description.zh: 通话唯一标识；参数cno,uniqueId和requestUniqueId三选一
description.en: The unique call ID. Specify only one of the following parameters: Cno, UniqueId, or RequestUniqueId.
